huguenot-road-baptist-richmond.assessment: Huguenot Road Baptist is a Chesterfield County congregation serving the southwest Richmond area. Led by Dr. Robert E. Lee IV, the church emphasizes community and biblical engagement. The pastor's weekly letters touch on faith and current events, indicating an engaged shepherd. Standard BGAV concerns apply — moderate denomination that separated from SBC over inerrancy and gender. Dr. Lee's doctorate and consistent pastoral communication suggest a serious minister, but his theological positions on inerrancy, complementarianism, and soteriology need direct confirmation before recommending. A visit and conversation with Dr. Lee would quickly reveal whether this church holds conservative convictions within a moderate denomination.

huntersville-arp-nc.assessment: Huntersville ARP Church is an Associate Reformed Presbyterian congregation in the Charlotte, NC metro area led by Senior Pastor Nick Napier, a North Carolina native. The church maintains a full weekly rhythm including Sunday morning worship (Sunday School 8:45 AM, Worship 10:00 AM) and a Wednesday dinner-plus-classes schedule from September through May. As an ARP church, it holds the Westminster Standards with male-only ordination — aligning cleanly with MOOP's biblical-design rubric. This is a green-rated orthodox Reformed option in the Charlotte suburbs, currently seeking an associate pastor (per the church's pastor-search page).
